_doc: The ~/flakes/{system,hm} layout and the Android host tools. bake_default_packages.py renders the templates in this directory (placeholders @NAME@, filled from build.json::forks.nixdroid.bootstrap.default_packages and bootstrap-src/bootstrap-src.json, never restated here) into the zip at install_dir, and seed.sh copies them into $HOME/<home_dir>/ on login, once per file: a file that already exists is never overwritten, so the user's edits survive every login and every app update.

android_host._doc: The proot in bin/login runs WITHOUT -r: the guest root is the host root, so /system is the real one already, and upstream's own `-b /:/android` exposes it a second time at /android/system. What was missing on the phone is the tools on PATH and an environment bionic binaries tolerate. android-host-exec runs /system/bin/<tool> (or /android/system/bin/<tool>) with the glibc loader variables removed. android-ls and android-ps run toybox's ls and ps without shadowing coreutils. The same wrapper ships in the baked zip (bin_dir, on PATH through the fallback init script) and in the system flake's environment.packages (android-host-tools), so a switched generation keeps them.
